gloss: loading; now loading; reading in progress

definitions.gloss: loading; now loading; reading in progress
definitions.explanation: Commonly seen on screens while data is being loaded

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}らないで→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not turn off the computer while data is loading.

examples.japanese: ⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: An error occurred while loading the file, so please try again.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{読|よ}み{込|こ}み→読み込み：09224_yomikomi⟧ (reading/loading data) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in progress). This is the standard Japanese equivalent of "Now Loading" seen on computer screens, apps, and game consoles. The term ⟦{読|よ}み{込|こ}み→読み込み：09224_yomikomi⟧ literally means "reading in" — the metaphor of a computer "reading" data from storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}: data loading in progress
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧{読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}: page loading
- {読|よ}み{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}...⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: loading... please wait a moment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ローディング: loading (English loanword; also common on screens)
- ⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}み→書き込み：09225_kakikomi⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: writing in progress (the reverse operation — saving data)
- {処理中|しょりちゅう}: processing (broader term for any ongoing computation)
- ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧: preparing (used for services/shops not yet ready, not for data)

COMMON PATTERNS:
The suffix ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ attaches to many action nouns to mean "in the middle of doing X": ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ (under construction), ⟦{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}→営業中：09539_eigyouchuu⟧ (open for business), {充電中|じゅうでんちゅう} (charging).
